About us

Honest coffee, roasted in Cam Ranh

Calm Coffee Supply is a small team in Cam Ranh, Khánh Hòa. We started with a simple wish: a cup of coffee that tastes like the coffee bean.

Why we started

A lot of coffee is roasted with butter, sugar and flavorings, so it's hard to know what you're really drinking. We wanted to share clean, honest coffee: just the beans, carefully roasted. What is pure-roast coffee?

Beans from the Central Highlands, roasted in Cam Ranh

We choose Arabica and Robusta from skilled producers in Vietnam's Central Highlands (Tây Nguyên), then pure-roast every batch ourselves in Cam Ranh. Every bag shows its roast date, so you always know how fresh it is.

Four seasons, four moods

Like the seasons, each roast has its own mood: bright Xuân (Spring) for a gentle morning, balanced Hạ (Summer) for every day, warm Thu (Autumn) for the afternoon, and deep Đông (Winter) when you need a strong cup.

You choose, we roast

Everyone's taste is different, so you can pick 100% Arabica, 100% Robusta or your own blend ratio, whole bean or ground.
